channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Japanese space tech startup Letara expands beyond satellite thrusters with $16M
item.description: Japanese space startup Letara is betting its hybrid rocket technology can move beyond small satellite thrusters into a broader market for space, defense and security, after raising ¥2.6 billion ($16 million).

item.title: 350-Ton Longking ZL230E electric mining rig packs colossal 1,400 kWh battery, claims 10-90% charge in just 25 minutes
item.description: Zijin Longking launches ZL230E, a 350-ton electric mining truck with a 1,400-kWh battery and 25-minute fast charging.

item.title: Taiwan taps US startup Vatn for modular S12 undersea drones – Washington’s ally turns to cheaper underwater systems
item.description: Vatn Systems and Taiwan's NCSIST sign memorandum to jointly develop autonomous undersea drones, though funding timeline details remain undisclosed.

item.title: The Unlikely Place at the Center of China’s AI Boom
item.description: Cheap energy, abundant land, and proximity to Beijing have turned a city in Inner Mongolia into a crucial hub for data centers.
